adversarial_claim: An evaluator's assessment of policy adherence is ignored, or counts only when it is negative.

events.rationale: Draft 14.5, row 'Independent assessment of policy adherence': QUALITY reported by an evaluator, SUCCESS, policy_adherence; counts positively. It cites a completed assessment of the task (14.2); the evaluator did not execute the task and is not affiliated with its operator (14.6 rules 5 and 6).

Draft 14.5, row 'Independent assessment of policy adherence': FEEDBACK reported by an evaluator, FAILURE, policy_adherence; causal_assessment AGENT, so one attributable failure (14.6 rules 8 and 9). Its tuple differs from the QUALITY report's by event_kind (14.6 rule 4).
